<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 2:22">Targ. Lam. II, 22</cite> <he>לפיפית</he> (some ed. <he>לפפית</he>).—
<cite ref="Shabbat 66b">Sabb. 66ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 147b:16">147ᵇ</cite> <he>לַפּוּפֵי ינוקא</he> to swathe a new-born child.—Part. pass. (<he>מְלַפַף</he>) <he>מְלַפַּף</he>.
<cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 34:15">Targ. II Chr. XXXIV, 15</cite> (of a scroll, v. <cite ref="L00646">preced.</cite>).
Targ. Lam. II, 20 (Ar. מִתְלַ׳ Ithpa.).—Trnsf. to handle in the way a child is swathed, to turn clay, mould, shape (cmp. עָצַב).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 74a:12">B. Mets. 74ᵃ</cite> <he>והא מחוסר לַפּוּפֵי ויבושי וכ׳</he> does it not require moulding, drying, putting into the stove &c.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 74a">Ib.</cite> <he>כגון דמְלַפְּפַן ומיבשן</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דמלפפה ויבישו</he>, corr. acc.) when they have been moulded and dried.
